# SparkSheets

> SparkSheets publishes practical Excel and Google Sheets tutorials: XLOOKUP vs VLOOKUP, pivot tables, conditional formatting, budget spreadsheets, and a formula cheat sheet.

SparkSheets.com is an independent tutorial site. Every tutorial includes copyable formulas and notes the differences between Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets. Not affiliated with Microsoft or Google.

## Pages

- [Home](https://sparksheets.com/): Step-by-step Excel and Google Sheets tutorials: XLOOKUP vs VLOOKUP, pivot tables, conditional formatting, a budget spreadsheet, and a formula cheat sheet.
- [XLOOKUP vs VLOOKUP: how to look up data in Excel and Google Sheets](https://sparksheets.com/xlookup-vs-vlookup.html): Side-by-side syntax, exact and approximate matches, left lookups, and common error fixes.
- [Pivot tables in Excel and Google Sheets: a beginner's guide](https://sparksheets.com/pivot-tables-guide.html): Prepare data, build a pivot, group dates, show percentages, and refresh results.
- [Conditional formatting in Excel and Google Sheets, with formula examples](https://sparksheets.com/conditional-formatting-guide.html): Built-in rules, color scales, and custom-formula rules for rows, due dates, and duplicates.
- [How to make a budget spreadsheet in Excel or Google Sheets](https://sparksheets.com/budget-spreadsheet-tutorial.html): Build a transactions log, category dropdowns, SUMIFS monthly totals, and budget-vs-actual alerts.
- [Essential Excel and Google Sheets formulas cheat sheet](https://sparksheets.com/spreadsheet-formulas-cheat-sheet.html): Copyable formulas for math, logic, lookups, text, dates, and dynamic arrays.

## About

- [About SparkSheets](https://sparksheets.com/about.html): SparkSheets is an independent tutorial site teaching practical Excel and Google Sheets skills with copyable formulas and clear notes on how the two apps differ.
